question.text:
Paragraph: Two aliphatic aldehydes $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ react in the presence of aqueous $\mathrm{K}_2 \mathrm{CO}_3$ to give compound R, which upon treatment with HCN provides compound $\mathrm{S}$. On acidification and heating, S gives the product shown below :
Question: $$ \text { The compound } S \text { is } $$

solution.text:
Some inferences from above data - $a q \mathrm{~K}_2 \mathrm{CO}_3$ can facilitate aldol condensation to aliphatic aldehydes. - HCN can lead to cyanohydrin formation - $\mathrm{H}^{+}, \Delta$ can lead to hydrolysis of cyanide to acid and following esterification. So $S$ is cyanohydrin.
